hypotheses: H1: an optimized agent-braid-analyze guidance (best APO or GEPA candidate selected on the development set only) meets D4 on the frozen SPEC-069 held-out set in each required host where the T010 baseline missed D4. A null or negative result completes the protocol.
observation_contract: Development and held-out rollouts recorded per SPEC-071; candidate lineage, optimizer template, input and transcript hashes, contamination checks and stop reasons recorded; held-out runs only after the protocol hash is frozen.

obtained_evidence.limits: The freeze binds the protocol bytes, not reviewer intent; approval is the owner's merge of the freeze pull request. One required host (claude-code); opencode is a declared limit per Amendment 1. Development scores are descriptive; H1 is decided on held-out (T010).
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: The owner reviewed and approved protocol Amendment 1 (items 1-6) on 2026-11-13 before any development rollout; the development phase ran (A0 27/30 first attempt; best GEPA 0.967, best APO 0.233 on the full development set; claude-code, model claude-sonnet-5-5, subscription route; evidence/development-arms.json). evidence/protocol-freeze.json records the sha256 of evaluation-protocol.md and of the development evidence, with the held-out set unopened. The committed freeze matches the protocol. obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: With the preregistered parameters (beam 2, branch 2, 2 rounds, minibatch 5, 2 hosts, 3 repetitions) APO runs 1 then 2 parents with 2 then 4 children, 9 optimizer calls and 120 rollouts (20 + 40 search, 60 full evaluation of the best), as in the feasibility table; every APO candidate records its parent, round, two call ids, both passed contamination checks and the hash of the critique and edit templates; configuration defaults stop at the 120-rollout cap (unit-cap), configured rounds above 3 are capped at 3, the optimizer-call cap stops the run, and unusable edits are failed calls without candidates. obtained_evidence.limits: Fake optimizer and synthetic rewards; no model contacted. Implemented from the paper's description; no GEPA or DSPy code. The pre-call scan and sandboxed host are evidenced by procedure_006.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: The Pareto front over per-prompt D4 scores keeps exactly the non-dominated candidates (a dominated candidate and an equal score vector are excluded) and parent sampling follows the number of prompts each front member scores best on (0.75 observed for 3 of 4 prompts); a child whose minibatch score beats its parent's is accepted, fully evaluated (60 rollouts) and replaces the dominated seed on the front, while children that do not improve are recorded with a minibatch score only and never fully evaluated; with the preregistered settings a run costs 3 minibatches of 10 plus one full evaluation, and a second accepted child whose full evaluation would exceed 120 rollouts is not evaluated (unit-cap); the reflection input holds only the parent text and the parent's minibatch vectors; the same seed repeats parent and minibatch choices; an unusable reflection is a failed call. Negative control: an optimizer outside the runner channel is refused (optimizer-bypass).

scenarios.then: the front contains exactly the non-dominated candidates and non-improving children are rejected.

requirements.text: lightning_gepa keeps a Pareto front over per-prompt reward vectors, samples parents by front dominance, mutates by reflection on the content-free minibatch reward vectors, score_case reasons, refusal codes and parent text (transcript reflection is an optional later mode gated on SPEC-074 consent), accepts a child only if its minibatch score exceeds the parent's, then evaluates it on the full development set; no code is vendored.

scenarios.given: an optimizer input containing a held-out case id

obtained_evidence.limits: Fake Claude Code host; no model contacted. The scan matches exact 8-word windows after normalization: paraphrased held-out content is not detected. Windows shared with development prompts are not fingerprinted (held-out prompts keep 11 to 45 windows each). Sandbox denial is asserted only on macOS (sandbox-exec); elsewhere real optimizer calls are refused.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: The committed held-out fingerprints (sha256 of held-out case ids and of every 8-word normalized window of the held-out prompts not shared with a development prompt) are reproducible and bound to the FREEZE hash of held-out.json; the analyze skill body and every development prompt pass the scan; a held-out 8-word excerpt in different case and spacing, a held-out case id (by pattern and by hash), the held-out canary planted only in held-out rollout workspaces, and the rollout canary are refused (holdout-contamination); stale fingerprints are refused (holdout-fingerprint-stale); the channel checks before every call and a refused input never reaches the host. The sandboxed optimizer host runs Claude Code with no tools, no plugin and an empty working directory in a disposable profile without API keys; its protected paths include held-out.json, the SPEC-069 scoring and fixture sources and .git, and on macOS the isolation probe is enforced and a read of held-out.json under the sandbox fails; teardown is clean. Negative controls: an unverified credential source (route-unverified), a paid key in the parent environment (paid-route-refused), OpenCode as optimizer host (route-unverified) and a non-fake in-process transport (isolation-failed) are refused.

scenarios.given: budgets set low in a fake run

obtained_evidence.limits: Fake optimizer and synthetic rewards; no model contacted. Resume is exercised through the algorithm API; wiring the algorithms into `agent-braid lightning run` with real candidate evaluation is T009 work.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: With budgets set low in fake runs each algorithm stops at the first applicable rule and records it in the run journal: unit-cap (APO at configuration defaults), optimizer-cap, no-improvement after 2 consecutive flat rounds, and a weekly-stop quota stop that carries the explicit `agent-braid lightning run --resume <run-id>` command; a refused optimizer input (holdout-contamination) stops the run with the refusal recorded and no call made; APO never runs more than 3 rounds; no run exceeds its rollout or optimizer-call cap (negative control). Resuming a quota-stopped APO or GEPA run with the same seed replays the journaled optimizer outputs and evaluations in order and reaches the same rounds, best candidate, rollouts and calls as an uninterrupted run without repeating any optimizer call; resuming with another seed or configuration is refused (resume-diverged). The journal is private and refuses unknown entry shapes.

scenarios.then: it stops at the first applicable rule and records that reason.

requirements.text: Runs stop at maxRollouts, maxOptimizerCalls, rounds, a quota stop (which ends the run; resumption only by lightning run --resume <run-id>), or 2 rounds without development improvement; APO defaults to at most 3 rounds; budgets are per arm run; the stop reason is recorded.

scientific_limits: Ten held-out prompts and three repetitions give wide intervals; the decision follows the preregistered D4 rule only. Results describe observed host versions, models and prompt sets and do not generalize to other skills, hosts or tasks.
